subject.title: ci: defer macOS tests for draft pull requests

question: Should a code-changing draft PR be allowed to record a successful aggregate required check before its macOS shards run when the same head is promoted to ready for review?
rationale: The implementation is internally coherent, but whether aggregate-green deferral is an acceptable merge-gate policy and whether same-SHA check behavior is safe require repository-owner intent and branch-protection verification.

options.title: Verify then approve deferral
options.body: Use a controlled test PR to confirm that the ready-for-review run immediately supersedes the same-SHA draft success and blocks merging until both macOS shards pass.

options.title: Keep deferred gate non-successful
options.body: Adjust the required-check design so draft deferral remains visibly non-successful and cannot satisfy ready-state mergeability.

recommendation.title: Verify then approve deferral
recommendation.body: Use a controlled test PR to confirm that the ready-for-review run immediately supersedes the same-SHA draft success and blocks merging until both macOS shards pass.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available owner for required-check and hosted-runner policy.
